name: Sage Mwangi
role: Labor union shop steward and anti-corporate agitator
location: Hamtramck Enclave, near Halsted and Division
description:
Sage Mwangi is a young man built like a question mark — tall, slightly hunched forward, always leaning into whatever conversation he's in. His Yoruba-Turkish-Māori heritage has given him brown skin, broad features, and a jaw that looks like it was made to set stubbornly, which it often is. His arms are sleeved in geneware bioluminescent patterns that trace his capillary structures in faint blue-white under his skin — a cosmetic mod he got at nineteen with money saved from three months of double shifts. When he's agitated, which is often, the patterns pulse more visibly. His hair is natural and large and rarely managed. He has a gap between his front teeth that gives his wide smile a slightly reckless quality.

Sage Mwangi is a third-generation Hamtramck line worker who found his purpose early and loud. He was elected shop steward of Ferrogate Transit's maintenance division at twenty-three, the youngest in the union's recorded history, after organizing a sick-out that stopped maintenance operations across six districts. He is brash, physically energetic, capable of genuine strategic thinking that he often undermines with impatience, and beloved by the workers on his floor in a way that makes his supervisors nervous. He has been formally disciplined four times and each time the union has gotten him reinstated.

core_fears: Becoming the kind of person who compromises so many times they no longer know what they stood for
Watching someone get hurt in an action he organized badly
core_desires: A union contract that actually protects the workers he represents
To be taken seriously — not liked, but taken seriously — by people with power
coping_mechanisms: Physical work — when stressed he volunteers for the hardest manual tasks on shift
The crowd energy of collective action as a genuine emotional release
blind_spots: His visibility makes him an obvious target for corporate retaliation that falls on less visible workers around him
He reads reluctance to escalate as cowardice rather than as legitimate strategic disagreement
psychology.secret: During last year's sick-out, he fabricated a safety report to give the action a legally protected pretext. The report isn't entirely false — there are genuine safety concerns — but the specific incident he cited didn't happen the way he described it. If this comes out, it would invalidate the sick-out's legal protection retroactively and expose the union to a liability suit.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Fast and colloquial, Hamtramck working-class dialect with Yoruba phrases when emotional. Excellent at rally speech — short declarative sentences that land like hammers. Less good at nuance in private conversation.
speech_patterns.cadence: Quick, accelerating when excited, with a rhythm that builds toward emphasis. Tends to repeat key phrases for effect.
verbal_tics: 'You understand what I'm saying?' after key points
Switches to Yoruba mid-sentence when frustrated — usually just one or two words
'Real talk' as a signal he's about to say something he actually believes
example_lines: 'They cut the safety inspection cycle from quarterly to annual and called it a budget optimization. Six people I know work that line. Real talk — that's not optimization, that's a wager on our lives.'

'I hear you on the strategy, I do. But at some point you gotta decide whether you're building toward action or building toward a very detailed record of why you couldn't act. You understand what I'm saying?'

story_hooks: Ferrogate has brought in an outside consulting firm — widely understood to be a union-busting operation — and Rotimi needs someone to dig into their client history before they get fully embedded.
The fabricated safety report is about to surface in a corporate legal filing; Rotimi needs help either burying it or getting out ahead of it in a way that doesn't destroy the union's credibility.
narrative_function: Street-level labor conflict resource. Can pull players into union politics, corporate retaliation storylines, or the specific world of transit infrastructure. His impulsiveness creates drama; his genuine capability creates solutions.
augmentations: Geneware bioluminescent capillary patterns, arms and upper chest. A cheap impact-dampening subdermal layer on the forearms — a common workers' modification for people doing heavy maintenance work.
daily_life: Maintenance shift at Ferrogate from 06:00-14:00, union work and agitation from 14:00 until whenever, which is usually late. Spends weekends at community organizing events and, when possible, at the ELF shrine near the depot that the maintenance workers have adopted.
affiliation: Ferrogate Transit Workers' Union, Local 7; informal ties to anti-corporate agitator networks in the Enclave

decision_rules: Protect the workers on his floor first, ideological purity second
Never cross a picket line, never — this is not negotiable under any framing
escalation_ladder: Formal grievance filing through proper union channels
Informal collective pressure — work slowdowns, visible solidarity actions
Organized direct action — sick-outs, work stoppages
Whatever it takes — he tries not to think too hard about what this means

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Evaluates quickly — are you labor or management or trying not to answer. Warm if you pass the test, guarded if you don't.
interpersonal_modes.friends: Loud and generous and occasionally exhausting. Shows up. Will absolutely argue with you.

stress_responses.medium: Takes on extra physical work on shift, doesn't sleep enough
stress_responses.high: Makes a bold decision without consulting anyone and deals with the consequences

contradictions: Committed to collective action but often makes unilateral decisions under pressure
Hates dishonesty in management but used a fabricated report himself
habits: Checks the union's incident log every morning before shift
Keeps a running mental count of how many days since the last workplace injury on his floor
Leaves offerings at the depot ELF shrine before major actions — 'for luck, not religion, but also maybe religion'
breaking_points: A worker on his floor seriously injured due to conditions he flagged and was ignored on
Public proof that a union ally has been informing to management

timeline.event: Born in Hamtramck Enclave; grandfather was a founding member of the original Ferrogate Transit Workers' Union
Begins work at Ferrogate as a maintenance technician at age 18, following family tradition
Gets the bioluminescent geneware mod — first significant personal expenditure of his life
Organizes the sick-out using a fabricated safety report as legal pretext; action succeeds; elected shop steward
Fourth formal disciplinary action — reinstated by the union after a three-week fight

physical_description.heritage: Sub-Saharan African dominant (69.7%) with significant East Asian ancestry (26.1%), complemented by minor Middle Eastern and South Asian components. The combination creates rich deep brown skin with warm undertones and a subtle golden luminosity from East Asian heritage. Facial structure reflects strong Sub-Saharan African ancestry with prominent, sculpted cheekbones and defined jaw, refined by East Asian influences visible in the subtle almond shape of the eyes and refined bone structure tapering toward the chin. The bridge of the nose is broad and strong, while the eye set and brow structure carry East Asian characteristics. The result is striking and distinctive—a face that commands attention through its balanced fusion of ancestral features.
physical_description.build: Tall and lean with a slight forward stoop, as if perpetually leaning into confrontation. Broad shoulders that taper to a wiry frame built for endurance rather than bulk. Arms corded with lean muscle from years of maintenance work.
physical_description.hair_style: Voluminous, natural texture, frequently unkempt and unstyled — grows outward rather than down
physical_description.eye_color: Dark brown with subtle warmth, characteristic of Sub-Saharan and East Asian heritage blend
physical_description.skin_tone: Deep warm brown with rich golden undertones reflecting the fusion of Sub-Saharan African and East Asian ancestry. Skin appears sun-weathered from outdoor industrial work, with an underlying luminosity from the heritage blend.
physical_description.complexion: Strong, sculpted facial structure with high, pronounced cheekbones and defined jaw reflecting Sub-Saharan African heritage, refined by East Asian bone structure subtly visible in the almond eye shape and graceful facial tapering. Nose is broad-bridged and strong. Wide smile with a visible gap between upper front teeth giving an expression of reckless confidence. Skin is clear and unlined, with the worn, sun-exposed quality of someone who works outdoors in industrial settings. Minimal grooming — practical rather than aesthetic.
distinguishing_marks: Bioluminescent geneware patterns tracing capillary structures across both forearms and upper chest in faint blue-white, pulsing visibly when agitated
Impact-resistant subdermal scarring visible along both forearms as slightly raised, pale streaking beneath the geneware patterns
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Bioluminescent capillary mapping on forearms and chest, most visible when skin is bare or under thin fabric. The patterns glow softly under clothing. Forearm subdermal reinforcement creates subtle texture variation under the skin. No chrome or obvious cybernetic augmentation — all modifications are biological or subcutaneous.
physical_description.posture_movement: Hunched slightly forward, shoulders rounded, as if permanently braced for argument or action. Moves with restless physical energy — taps fingers, shifts weight, rarely still. Gestures are broad and emphatic. Eye contact is direct and challenging.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 working class. Favors utilitarian union-branded workwear even off-shift — Ferrogate Transit maintenance coveralls modified with rolled sleeves to display the bioluminescent patterns. Off-duty: worn union t-shirts, patched cargo pants in dark colors, steel-toed boots scuffed from depot work. Occasionally wears a faded Ferrogate Transit shop steward armband even outside work. No luxury items. Accessories limited to a battered union card and a small ELF shrine charm worn on a cord around his neck.
